5d564b58c11c-holed.answer: Governments should promote integrated pest management as a sustainable alternative to chemical pesticides. IPM relies on monitoring and on natural predators such as ladybirds and spiders, so beneficial insects survive instead of being killed by broad-spectrum sprays. It can also lower costs: after Indonesia adopted IPM for rice in 1986, it phased out its pesticide subsidies.
